_source: Task 0 follow-up probe (#10), Claude Code 2.1.277, 2026-09-29. PostToolUseFailure payload for a wrapped call: a PreToolUse hook returned permissionDecision: allow plus updatedInput rewriting the command to 'exit 7'. tool_input carries the REWRITTEN command, tool_use_id matches the PreToolUse event for the same call, error is 'Exit code N', and is_interrupt is false. A plain (non-wrapped) non-zero exit and a tool-timeout kill produced the same shape, differing only in tool_input and error (e.g. 'Exit code 143\nCommand timed out after 1s' for a timeout kill).
